VIRIDIS_KEYWORD_CULTIVATE.title: Cultivate
VIRIDIS_KEYWORD_CULTIVATE.description: Put the selected card in your Cultivate Pile. At the start of your turn, reduce its remaining turns by 1. The wait is based on the card’s base Energy cost, with a minimum of 1 and a maximum of 3. X-cost cards take 1 turn. When ready, you usually harvest a card one rarity higher. Ancient cards yield two copies of the same card instead.
VIRIDIS_KEYWORD_PERMANENT_CULTIVATE.desc: When cultivated, this card stays in your Cultivate Pile permanently and never yields a card. Playing it does not cultivate it. Other effects can still remove it.
VIRIDIS_KEYWORD_WITHER.title: Wither
VIRIDIS_KEYWORD_WITHER.description: Remove a card from your Cultivate Pile. It is not harvested, and the original card is not returned.
VIRIDIS_KEYWORD_VIEWER_COUNT.title: Viewer
VIRIDIS_KEYWORD_VIEWER_COUNT.description: Gain 1 whenever you play a card. Resets to 0 at the end of your turn.
VIRIDIS_KEYWORD_EARWORM.title: Earworm
VIRIDIS_KEYWORD_EARWORM.description: At the start of your turn, gain Viewer equal to your Earworm stacks.
VIRIDIS_KEYWORD_BACKLASH.title: Anti-Stomp
VIRIDIS_KEYWORD_BACKLASH.description: The first X cards you play each turn do not grant Viewer.
VIRIDIS_KEYWORD_CHUANZI.title: Troll
VIRIDIS_KEYWORD_CHUANZI.description: At the start of your turn, gain X random stacks of Vigor or Stretch.
VIRIDIS_KEYWORD_FARMER_FORM.title: Farmer Form
VIRIDIS_KEYWORD_FARMER_FORM.description: Cultivate progress and harvested card count are increased by 1 each turn.
VIRIDIS_KEYWORD_GROW.title: Grow
VIRIDIS_KEYWORD_GROW.description: Reduce the remaining turns of all non-permanent crops in your Cultivate Pile by X. X is set by the card.
VIRIDIS_KEYWORD_LURKING.description: Both Earworm and Backlash are 0. Has no passive effect.
VIRIDIS_KEYWORD_DEFERRED.title: Deferred
VIRIDIS_KEYWORD_DEFERRED.description: This card is never in your opening hand.
VIRIDIS_KEYWORD_PLANT_IN.title: Plant In
VIRIDIS_KEYWORD_LURKING.title: Lurking
